record.paper_title: Group actions on 4-manifolds: some recent results and open questions
record.context_brief: Describing bounds for smooth Z_p-actions via manifold invariants
record.original_question: For general smooth Z_p-actions, can the constant C from Question 4.1 be described in terms of invariants of the manifold? In particular, which invariants of the smooth structure, such as Seiberg-Witten basic classes or Seiberg-Witten invariants, enter that bound, and in what way do they enter it?

evidence.quote: Question 4.3. (Chen [17]) For the general case of smooth Zp-actions, is the constant C in Question 4.1 “describable” in terms of invariants of the manifold? In particular, what invariants of the smooth structure (e.g. SW basic classes, SW invariants, etc.) will enter the constant and how do they enter the constant?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a closed, smooth, oriented 4-manifold. Consider smooth, effective actions of cyclic groups Z_p of prime order p on X. Suppose that for X (or for a suitable class of such 4-manifolds, for instance those admitting no smooth circle action) there exists a constant C = C(X) > 0 such that X admits no smooth Z_p-action whenever p > C; that is, the orders of prime-order smooth periodic diffeomorphisms of X are bounded by C.

Question: For general smooth Z_p-actions, can such a bound C be described explicitly in terms of invariants of the 4-manifold X? More precisely, identify which invariants of the smooth structure of X — for example the set of Seiberg–Witten basic classes of X, the values of the Seiberg–Witten invariants, or other gauge-theoretic invariants — must enter any such bound, and give an explicit formula or estimate showing how these invariants control the constant C.
artifact.status_search_result: The question, attributed to W. Chen, asks how the bound on orders of prime smooth Z_p-actions on a 4-manifold depends on smooth invariants such as Seiberg–Witten basic classes. Chen's Duke 2011 paper established such bounds in the holomorphic (topological) and symplectic (involving smooth structure) cases, but a general description of C in terms of SW invariants for arbitrary smooth Z_p-actions does not appear to have been obtained, and no later resolution was found in available searches. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the orders of periodic diffeomorphisms of 4-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Chen proves bounds on orders of smooth Z_p-actions for holomorphic and symplectic cases; in the symplectic case the bound involves the smooth structure.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for holomorphic/symplectic cases, but the general smooth case description in terms of SW invariants is not established.

status_evidence.title: Group Actions on Four-manifolds (Chen, minicourse notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the constant C bounding prime orders of smooth Z_p-actions and the role of smooth invariants.
status_evidence.claim: The dependence of C on smooth invariants such as SW basic classes is posed as an open question.
